snippet.title: ANGLE - FIRST TRAILER
snippet.description:
The mystery of RovenHill Hospital begins. ANGLE is coming.

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4255370/ANGLE

ANGLE is a psychological horror experience that focuses on pure atmosphere and tension. As a solo developer, my goal is to deliver a haunting experience without relying on cheap jump scares. Your perception is your only enemy in these corridors.

🌀 About the Game: Step into the shoes of a protagonist lost within the grimy and decaying halls of an abandoned hospital. Solve the puzzles, uncover the dark history of RovenHill, and try to maintain your sanity.

📅 Release Date: March 2, 2026 🎮 Platform: Steam (PC)

Support the Project: If you enjoyed the trailer, please Subscribe and Wishlist the game on Steam. Every single wishlist helps a solo indie developer more than you can imagine!

#AngleGame #IndieDev #HorrorTrailer #PsychologicalHorror #Steam #Gaming #NoJumpScares #RovenHill
